description_text: Proposed procurement for NSN 5330008098525 SEAL,PLAIN ENCASED: Line 0001 Qty 424 UI EA Deliver To: By: 0063 DAYS ADO This Solicitation may result in an Automated IDC (Indefinite Delivery Contract).
